nodes.label: ADR 0027: Plan F Scope (Platform-Admin Only)
nodes.rationale: Plan F is platform-admin-only operational UX layer on top of Plan E. Scope: F.1 (⌘K cross-tenant search, Notes tab, Tags+bulk ops), F.2 (/revenue MRR/ARR/churn, /comms outbox+template library), F.3 (Billing tab, invoice history, refund, tier change, coupons), F.4 (/renewals, /health, /webhooks log, /migrations runner). Out of scope: tenant self-serve management, self-serve signup, cross-tenant analytics, referral program, hard quota enforcement, per-tenant Neon region migration, in-app dispute response, Slack alerts. All routes under /dashboard/platform-admin/*.
alternatives_rejected: Single mega-phase (too long for one PR review)
Mix tenant-side surfaces into Plan F (ADR-0022 decides self-serve is separate)
Build tags as jsonb on organizations (see ADR-0029)
